description:
Mission Architects 
We are a team of aspiring innovators, developers, and problem-solvers participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our mission is to transform complex space exploration concepts into an engaging and interactive Space Mission Design Game.
summary:
ASTRA:BEYOND THE HORIZON is a browser-based 3D game where you design and fly a space mission, alone or with up to 4 other players. You pick a destination out of 12 worlds, choose an orbit, and build your spacecraft part by part (hull, engine, power, thermal, comms, instruments). The game checks your mass, power, heat and budget live while you build. Then you launch, deal with random problems like solar flares and comms dropouts, explore the Moon on foot or drive a rover on Mars, and get a grade from S to F.
We made it because spreadsheets are accurate but boring, and most space games ignore real limits. In ASTRA:BEYOND THE HORIZON, extra armor costs you Δv and solar panels get weak far from the Sun, so players learn why real engineers make trade-offs just by playing.
details:
ASTRA:BEYOND THE HORIZON is a browser-based 3D game where you design and fly a space mission, alone or with up to 4 other players. You pick a destination out of 12 worlds, choose an orbit, and build your spacecraft part by part (hull, engine, power, thermal, comms, instruments). The game checks your mass, power, heat and budget live while you build. Then you launch, deal with random problems like solar flares and comms dropouts, explore the Moon on foot or drive a rover on Mars, and get a grade from S to F.

Rather than a static planet viewer, ASTRA: Beyond the Horizon blends a 3D orbital sandbox, spacecraft engineering simulator, and exploration game—taking users from commander & crew selection, spacecraft subsystem design, and budget/launch-vehicle planning through liftoff, interplanetary transit, anomaly response, and surface exploration.

We prioritize scientific and engineering realism through accurate mission parameters, planetary conditions, and realistic exploration constraints, while maintaining accessibility through intuitive controls, difficulty presets, and visual telemetry. The application is designed for zero-backend performance, featuring client-side WebGL rendering, local checkpoints, and reliable error recovery. Safety and replayability are emphasized through in-flight anomaly management, abort and rescue assessments, crew synergies, and a persistent Mission Archive.

We made it because spreadsheets are accurate but boring, and most space games ignore real limits. In ASTRA:BEYOND THE HORIZON, extra armor costs you Δv and solar panels get weak far from the Sun, so players learn why real engineers make trade-offs just by playing.

Developed using TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, React 19, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand, with browser APIs for 3D rendering, audio, voice briefings, and local storage. Built and deployed using Vite, Node.js, Bun/npm, GitHub, and Vercel.
